sam_dev: Heads-up — we're seeing a cache hit-rate regression for Prefix/prompt caching on Private deployments vs Hosted/Dedicated. Quick numbers: hosted 89% hit, dedicated 85%, private 62%. p50 token latency: hosted ~45ms, private ~120ms. p99 endpoints: hosted ~380ms, private ~820ms. Notable spike aligns with recent private config syncs.

mike_runtime: Can you share the profiling + netstore latency? Is this across all private customers or a subset?

sam_dev: Subset so far (2 customers). Netstore reads for prefix entries are 10-20x slower on their VPC NFS mount vs hosted netstore (median read ~8ms hosted vs ~65ms private, with long tail). Also seeing many local cache misses even for repeated sessions.

lucy_sre: Which backend are they using for KV? NFS over VPC or remote redis? Any packet drops?

sam_dev: NFS over VPC (netstore tier). Also discovered a config drift: `cache_key_normalization` was false on those private deploys — different normalization across routers produced logically distinct keys for identical prompt prefixes. That explains some miss rate.

jeff_infra: That config drift likely came from the private bootstrap script change two weeks ago. We also have `enable_local_memstore=false` in the private template (was true for hosted/dedicated).

anya_prod: Another contribution: batching heuristics. Private cluster had aggressive cross-session batching to keep GPUs saturated. That groups requests with different prefixes in the same batch which increases cache thrash and evictions (we saw shorter KV TTLs used when batches are heterogeneous). Suggest we bias batching towards session-locality.

mike_runtime: Profiling shows kernel-selection latency up ~18% on cold runs because the runtime waits on KV load before selecting optimized kernels for long-prefix sequences. Logs: ```[2026-03-15T12:02:13Z] model=rw-large prefix_key=abc123 miss netstore_read=72ms; kernel_select_wait=18ms; batch_assemble_wait=9ms```

sam_dev: Proposed immediate mitigations (prioritized):
- Flip `cache_key_normalization=true` in private config and push via infra canary.
- Enable `enable_local_memstore=true` for private/dedicated to reduce netstore trips for hot prefixes.
- Turn on session-affinity at the router layer for private tenants (sticky header) so repeated session requests hit the same agent/worker.
- Adjust batching heuristics: prefer same-session grouping and cap cross-session batch size when netstore miss rate > 20%.
- Implement lightweight warmup prefetch for pinned models: proactive read of top-K prefixes at model load.

lucy_sre: Rollout plan: canary to single private tenant -> observe hit-rate + p99 for 24h -> expand to other affected tenants. Rollback: re-enable previous config flags and clear memstore if we see degradation. I'll own rollback automation.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra-ops/private-cache-fixes -> started 2m ago; ETA ~2h for canary. :rocket:

anya_prod: Post-fix monitoring: I'll collect hourly hit-rate, netstore latency, batching composition (session vs cross-session) and tail latencies. Goal: private hit-rate >= 82% within 24h and p99 <= 420ms.

mike_runtime: Also a medium-term follow-up: add a lightweight key-compat-checker that validates normalized key equivalence during config changes, and a smoke test that simulates bursty cross-session batching to catch regressions pre-deploy.

sam_dev: Thanks — I'll add the checklist to the incident ticket and paste the canary dashboard link when ready. If the canary fails we'll fallback to dedicated deployment for those customers and notify CS. :thumbsup:
